name: showreel-c3-line-spacing

voice.text: Nobody can cook from this. The lines are too tight. Turns out, lines need air. Fix one: more space between lines. Fix two: space between steps. Fix three: number each step. Easy to cook from.

caption:
Nobody can cook from this. The lines are too tight. 🍋

1. More space between lines. Line spacing of about 120 to 145% of the text size keeps each line easy to follow.
2. Space between steps. A gap of half to a whole line height shows where one step ends.
3. Number each step. With a spoon in one hand, you find your place at a glance.

Save this for your next recipe, guide or how-to. Do you cook from your phone or from paper?

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a recipe card on a kitchen counter) fills the frame by design
